name: Claude-Installer
$comment: Declarative catalog of what this installer provisions. Claude Code only - no Cursor, no Codex, no Claude Desktop. Descended from Alfred (andrewcornell2000-Work/Alfred), which targeted three harnesses from one catalog; the split targets were the source of the drift this repo exists to remove.

work.notes: Default. Reproduces the verified working set. Key-gated servers (fal-ai, firecrawl, supabase) self-skip when their keys are absent.

minimal.notes: GitHub, context7, filesystem only. Smallest always-on tool context.

analyst.notes: No browsing or webdev MCPs. Matches Alfred's old work default.

npx-mcps.upgrade: resolved at spawn via @latest - nothing pinned locally

uvx-mcps.upgrade: resolved at spawn - nothing pinned locally

skill_buckets.$comment: Gated separately from MCP buckets. A skill's description line is a permanent context cost whether or not it is ever used; its body loads only on trigger. Default set is 36 of 53 skills, about 1,599 tokens.
